subject: TAKING (per root) lazy CPU mapping + diagnostics: compute_frontend.m tegu_buffer_bytes/newBufferWithLength/contents, bridge n2mb_map; compositor_submit.inc break reasons; perf/pass counters; per-phase COMMAND_FAILED caps
body: Plan: (1) TeguBuffer BOs are no longer mapped at creation; tegu_buffer_bytes()/contents map on first CPU access (thread-safe, once), so a buffer/texture the CPU never touches stays out of 0096 per-job maintenance. Texture creation (texture agent) is unchanged: it allocates through newBufferWithLength, so textures inherit it. NOT allocating private textures GPU-only yet: blit encoder copies run on the CPU (tegu_buffer_bytes on t->buffer), which a GPU-only BO cannot do; lazy mapping gets the same effect for every texture that is never blitted/read back. n2mb_map becomes idempotent (returns the existing mapping if the bridge mapped first). (2) diagnostics: break reasons split msaa vs mrt, and rdtgt -> tile (shouldn't occur) / memfetch / owntex; TEGU_PERF_PASS line (passes, attachments 1/2/3+, per-attachment load clear/load/dontcare, store/dontcare, draws/pass histogram, clear-only and empty passes); TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED capped per A/B phase (16 each) plus a per-window failure count. Texture agent: tell me if you are editing compute_frontend.m newBufferWithLength or texture creation right now; encode agent: I will re-read compositor_submit.inc before the 2 hunks in tegu_jm_batch_draw_reason.
